assertions: Temporal adjacency preserves signed gaps and simultaneous intervals.
Every Phase 3 overlap is projected or explicitly marked untranscribed.
Simultaneous interruption requires explicit overlap support.
Immediate takeover requires bounded temporal and incomplete-terminal evidence.
Possible resumptions require compatible explicit attribution and intervening activity.
Continuation cycles and impossible ordering are rejected.
Persistence is deterministic, sealed, reloadable, and cache-safe.
CLI queues expose interruption, continuation, overlap, and adjacency evidence.
limitations: Temporal candidates do not establish intent, blame, dominance, or quality.
Supportive interjections and backchannels are not inferred.
Continuation candidates do not use semantic similarity and remain unresolved.
